Swim with the manatees in Kings Bay.verification: Downloaded the original (2616x3904) from Wikimedia Commons and inspected it directly: a wild Florida manatee at the surface of clear spring-fed water. The Commons file page and its Flickr source (USFWS Endangered Species photostream, credited to David Hinkel) caption it as being photographed in the Crystal River National Wildlife Refuge, the refuge that encompasses Kings Bay -- the exact body of water named in this pick. No identifiable people in frame.
